physicalNotes: Radius 0.491 +/- 0.015 solar radii from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-1467 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract): 341,589 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.489 +/- 0.02 solar masses from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-1467 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3834 +/- 157 K from Crossfield et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-1467 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025AJ....169...89C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
